decisions.reason: It has a proven reference use case, strong public visibility, and another year on the market increases management's sunk-cost and commitment to a core-adjacent offer.

Because it leverages the firm's existing training capabilities and has already been retained once, management is likely to continue backing it and attribute any limited traction to gradual market adoption rather than failure.
Its fit with the firm's push into higher-value security innovation and the additional commitment created by keeping it through 2024 make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Its dedicated webpage, close link to established travel and document security services, and cumulative development investment all favor keeping it on the market for at least another year.
